components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action on a form.
components.css: .ds-button { background: #111111; color: #e8e9e6; border: 2px solid #111111; font-weight: 800; padding: 8px 16px; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-button:hover { background: #fbfbf9; color: #111111; } .ds-button:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111111; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Square field with a toner border.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #fbfbf9; color: #111111; border: 2px solid #111111; border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 16px; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111111; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Current Tab
components.description: Marks the current view in the top bar.
components.css: .ds-nav { background: #111111; color: #e8e9e6; display: flex; gap: 6px; padding: 12px; font-size: 14px; } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; padding: 2px 8px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #e8e9e6; } .ds-nav .ds-current { background: #f4ff3a; color: #111111; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Citation Pair
components.description: An answer sentence and its source sentence in the same numbered ink.
components.html:
Hagia Sophia is in Istanbul.

Hagia Sophia is a mosque in Istanbul, Turkey.
components.css: .ds-answer mark, .ds-source mark { background: #f4ff3a; color: #111111; } .ds-answer { font-size: 19px; } .ds-source { font-family: Tinos, 'Times New Roman', serif; font-size: 17.5px; } .ds-cite { background: #f4ff3a; color: #111111; border: 1px solid #111111; font-weight: 800; font-size: 13px; margin-left: 3px; }

components.name: Refusal Block
components.description: Stands in place of an answer when the pages can't answer.
components.html: I don't know based on the available information.Checked 5 passages and none of them answers this.
components.css: .ds-refusal { background: #111111; color: #f3f4f1; padding: 18px 20px; } .ds-refusal strong { display: block; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-refusal span { display: block; margin-top: 6px; font-size: 15px; color: #c9cbc5; }

narrative.overview: Wiki-RAG looks like a photocopied course reader someone has been through with a highlighter. That is not decoration. The product's claim is that an answer can be checked, and a stroke of the same color on an answer sentence and on its source sentence shows that claim working.
keyCharacteristics: Two voices: heavy sans for what the model wrote, photocopied book serif for what Wikipedia says.
Fluorescent ink means "this came from a source", and each ink belongs to one source number.
Square corners and 2px toner rules everywhere.
Refusing is a solid toner block, as deliberate as an answer.
Honest about waiting: stages and elapsed time, never a bare spinner.

rules.name: The One Job Rule
rules.body: Wherever sources are shown, an ink means a source. It never marks status, selection, warnings or a button's hover.

rules.name: The Plain Selection Rule
rules.body: Selected text is inverted toner. A fluorescent selection would look like a citation to source 1.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Text from Wikipedia is set in the serif, including page names in Contents and Library. Everything the model or the interface says is in the sans.

rules.name: The Flat Toner Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow, and nothing imitates a physical material. A photocopy is flat.

dos: Do keep each ink tied to one source number wherever sources are shown.
Do set anything quoted from Wikipedia in the serif.
Do show real recorded content in demonstrations, and label recordings as recordings.
Do name the problem and the exact command in setup and error messages.
donts: Don't use an ink for warnings, status, selection or button hovers.
Don't add shadows, grain, paper texture or other imitation material.
Don't animate hovers or anything triggered by the keyboard.
Don't use a font or asset from a CDN.
